The assistant recommended 3-4 workout sessions per week and asked the user about their preferred workout times.
The user currently uses a habit tracker app to keep track of daily and weekly tasks, as well as meditation and exercise routine.
The user felt refreshed and like a completely recharged and different person after the last month of 2022.
The user did some exercises on playing with light and shadow during the workshop.
